render_contract.shell_point_count: ceil(30 * assembly_charge), plus one central variant-3 rock
render_contract.shell_point_distribution: Fibonacci sphere: y = 2*i/n - 1 + 1/n, theta = i*pi*(3-sqrt(5)); count, variants, and stored scales use assembly_charge, while post-contact 0x004029A0 renormalizes retained local XYZ vectors to radius 30*current_charge
render_contract.assembly_lifecycle: build once at constructor charge 0.18; replace only when floor(30*old_charge) differs from floor(30*new_charge); preserve count/variants/stored scales on release and actor contact, but rewrite every retained noncentral vector length after contact
render_contract.visual_root: actor XY plus shared-random radius [0,3] displacement and local Y -20-32.5*charge; Region light still samples actor XY
render_contract.persistent_aura: record 15; RGB (0.9,1,0.9), alpha random(0,0.25)+0.35, scale 4.1*charge; persists in hold and flight
render_contract.crossfade: record 86 additive alpha is m, scale is 2.5*m, rotation is global_render_tick*6 degrees; body alpha is 1-m; m starts at 1 and loses 0.035 per tick until zero
render_contract.ordering: transform local XYZ by Boulder +0x154 matrix, keep strict transformed Z > -40, sort ascending transformed Z, then draw main bank; rank-1 radius <= 30 makes the cull branch unreachable for valid shell rocks
render_contract.projection: 0x0043A8A0 copies transformed X/Y exactly and ignores Z; registration is Boulder actor transform plus that orthographic XY offset
render_contract.orientation: carry the authoritative row-major float32 3x3 matrix; while held postmultiply by a 0.75-degree row-vector Rodrigues rotation about the live heading-derived axis; release preserves the matrix; each surviving flight tick advances position then postmultiplies by hypot(storedDelta)/charge degrees before contact
render_contract.called_rock_auxiliary: with Enhanced Effects on and perspective height < 0, draw the same selected BadGuys[2008..2010] record first at base XY and 0.75 main scale, then the rotating full-scale main copy at y+height; otherwise main only

lighting.boulder: vslot +0x0C is Puppet_RenderDispatch and samples inbound Region light at Boulder world XY; independent vslot +0x30 provider 0x005E5670 submits the actor root with radius max(1,2*charge), intensity 0.5, and the retail Multiple-Shadows flag
lighting.called_rock: direct world-animation vslot +0x0C bypasses Puppet_RenderDispatch and ZAnimLitObject; no inbound Region sample and no outbound light
lighting.contact_fragment: one independent Anim_BoulderBit in a ZAnimLitObject wrapper per accepted actor; inbound Region sample and sort offset -15; no outbound light
lighting.breakup_fragment: independent ZAnimLitObject wrapper copies fragment XY, uses Puppet_RenderDispatch for inbound Region light, and has no outbound-light intensity/range fields
lighting.shadow: no direct BadGuys[67] shadow reference exists in Boulder draw

visual_samples: adjacent dust/fade and loose fragment emission
breakup fragment variant, direction, placement, scale, and lifetime
randomness.contact_boulder_bit: construction and bounce draws occur in the authoritative fixed-tick owner because the registered child outlives the contact and advances the shared native stream
randomness.web_consequence: keep render-only body jitter/aura samples isolated by stable identity; contact BoulderBit state and its later bounce draws are host-authored and replicated

lifecycle.hold: one cached actor follows the live staff emitter and aim while charge grows
lifecycle.release: 0x005E5450 flips +0x1DC/+0x1DD from held to flight without replacing identity, leaves release-base damage at +0x1F8, writes the released pool at +0x1F4, and writes actual release charge to +0x1FC
lifecycle.flight: straight motion and 0x00620B60 contact query every native tick; direction is the final held world-aim sample and does not home or retarget after release; the actor position is float32-advanced and the authoritative matrix rolls by stored-delta/charge before the query, so terminal breakup registers at that advanced and rotated sample; no native fixed timeout or range recovered
lifecycle.actor_contact: each new hostile handle consumes the residual pool, rewrites charge from the 0.35 pool-loss expression, emits one 0x0060BC10 BoulderBit, and after traversal renormalizes every retained shell vector plus bounds/radius; pool <=0.001 stops only that tick, pool <=0 invokes terminal breakup
lifecycle.impact: 0x0060B700 restores saved charge, emits independently rooted Anim_BoulderBit children inside ZAnimLitObject wrappers, registers the wrappers, then removes the Boulder; the semantic event must retain native global birth tick for modulo-three motion
lifecycle.interruption: dispatcher/player primary transition and world actor teardown stop gather ownership; destructor clears both lists; web owner removal, death, scene replacement, and disconnect must remove the semantic actor/effects and balance loops

historical_capture.classification: instrumented stock multiplayer observer evidence; not a clean-stock rerun
historical_capture.interpretation: shows an assembled multi-rock cluster at the caster's right-hand/staff emitter with a bright center effect; static instructions identify the mature effect as persistent record 15 rather than the expired record-86 opening flash; the frame corroborates composition and attachment but is not an exact timing/count oracle

bounded_unknowns: A clean-stock 2026-08-14 hold/release/terrain-impact capture was unavailable because unrelated isolated stock processes owned the desktop.
The exact shared-RNG seed/order and its interleaving with unrelated actors are unrecovered and intentionally not promoted into browser gameplay state.
No direct Boulder shadow sprite call was recovered; generic world lighting/tint remains a sibling renderer responsibility.
web_platform_constraint: Strict JSON cannot encode the native zero-base/zero-pool NaN contact-child scale. Consume its constructor RNG budget, omit that unrenderable one-child state, and retain the finite terminal breakup.
